Regression parts for cad/fold_back.py (tests/unit/cad/test_fold_back.py), unchanged from their sources.

helmholtz_coil.step - CERN-OHL-P-2.0
  https://github.com/scalinq-lab/cryomagsens/blob/main/mechanical_designs/helmholtz_coil/helmholtz_coil_assembly.step
  Planes meeting cylinders tangentially: tangent cusps, never a fold.

fw_hinge_r.stp - CC-BY-4.0, Framework Computer
  https://github.com/FrameworkComputer/Framework-Laptop-13/blob/main/Hinges/13_5_hinge_R_assy.stp
  A real fold: two faces on top of each other beside an edge (0.00 mm at 1 mm in).

fc_folding_chair.step - CC-BY-3.0, FreeCAD library
  https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD-library/blob/master/Industrial%20Design/Chairs/wooden%20folding%20chair.step
  20 parts; its two frames (Part_1, Part_3) cross themselves where only the Boolean check sees it -
  the mesh must fail fast at those faces and say the CAD needs repair there (MESH-2).
